claims.statement: DORA establishes standardized ICT incident reporting and third-party information registers for financial entities.
Demand hypothesis: MSPs can monetize recurring evidence readiness because ENISA guidance explicitly maps NIS2 measures to examples of evidence.

contrary_evidence: Security platforms already retain logs and compliance evidence.
Cyber insurers may require their own forms and forensic vendors.

economics.acquisition_route: One MSP can embed the vault across dozens of regulated clients.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 1000 clients at 600 PLN monthly can exceed 7 million PLN ARR and support founder net worth above 5 million PLN in five years.
economics.founder_time: Four to five hours daily until security operations are delegated.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 78-88% margin after secure storage and exception support.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 120 managed clients at 600 PLN monthly repay initial capital within eighteen months.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 300-900 PLN per client monthly plus 1500-5000 PLN per incident packet.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Evidence refreshes continuously and becomes valuable at every audit, renewal, and incident.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Control-to-evidence mappings and anonymized incident completeness benchmarks improve over time.
fingerprint.customer: EU MSPs, regulated SMEs, and cyber-insurance brokers.
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: MSPs and brokers bundle it with managed security or renewal services.
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: The vault maps recurring evidence to controls and generates time-bound incident reports without judging coverage.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: An MSP or broker pays per protected client monthly and per incident packet.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A control review or cyber incident requires logs, timelines, supplier records, and actions in several incompatible formats.

founder_fit: Technical and analytical work suits the founder.
Embedded MSP distribution reduces direct enterprise selling.
risks: A breach of the vault would be highly damaging.
The product must avoid compliance and coverage guarantees.

structure.control_point: The time-stamped control and incident evidence graph.
structure.critical_dependency: Secure log access and trusted MSP or broker distribution.

thesis: An MSP-embedded vault can continuously preserve control evidence and convert an incident into consistent regulator, client, and cyber-insurance packets.
title: Cyber Incident Evidence Vault for MSPs
uncertainties: Incident packet acceptance across insurers is unverified.
